text: A week has seven days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. I go to school every day from Monday to Friday. On the weekend, I stay home and rest with my family. There are twelve months in a year. January is the first month, and December is the last month. My birthday is in July, so I don't have school that day, and we always have a small party. I always look at the calendar to check the date before I make plans. Today is Thursday, tomorrow is Friday, and yesterday was Wednesday. I like Friday because the weekend comes next and I can sleep late on Saturday morning. Every morning, I wake up early and eat breakfast before school starts. This month, my family will visit my grandmother in another town, and we are all very happy about it. Next year, I will study a new subject at school. Time moves fast: today becomes yesterday, and tomorrow will soon be today too, so I try to enjoy every day and every month of the year.
